verdict.rationale: Warp's API documents endpoints to create and send candidate offers and manage their lifecycle, which covers sending offer letters. Nothing in the evidence describes e-signature, other HR documents, or document storage per employee. Missing for 10: e-signature capability, sending HR documents beyond offers, per-employee document storage, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can send offer letters and HR documents for e-signature and keep them stored per employee

citations.quote: Endpoints for managing candidate offers. Create and send offers, list existing offers, and manage their lifecycle.
